purpose: 12 complete original NativeZipper executions of the37-tape combined row-preparation caller. Nine maps at N=1, fractional/shift maps at N=2,row1, and pole map at N=4,row1. Includes negative coefficients/endpoints, empty/outside domains and boundary equality. Direct rational source-open and independent natural sign-component/product arithmetic check all source triples,image words,thresholds,crossings,source grid/four products,last three image products,input/templates/fuel,both prepared scratch tapes,all markers,halt and all37 unequal absolute heads. All31 work/output tapes start blank;dimension/index/seed resources are supplied. Source/image work remains stored;raw loading,outer rows and cleanup are not claimed.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.RowPreparationRun
open TransposeFollowup
def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]


def negativeMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -2; hi := -1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def zeroHiMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -1; hi := 0
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def negativeCoefficients : RationalMobius where
  a := -1; b := -2; c := 1; d := -3; lo := 4; hi := 5
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine RowPreparation

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def sourceIndex : SourceEndpoints.Port → Nat
  | .shared .dimension => 0 | .shared .index => 1 | .shared .unit => 2
  | .shared .zero => 3 | .shared .fuel => 4 | .shared .scratch => 5 | .shared .grid => 6
  | .shared (.work j) => 7+j.val | .shared (.out j) => 11+j.val | .other j => 14+j.val

def imageIndex : SourceImages.Port → Nat
  | .source p => sourceIndex p | .work j => 17+j.val | .out j b => 20+2*j.val+(if b then 1 else 0)
def portIndex : Port → Nat
  | .images p => imageIndex p | .threshold j => 28+j.val | .crossing j => 32+j.val | .temp => 36

def sourcePorts : List SourceEndpoints.Port :=
  ([EndpointClip.Port.dimension,.index,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.grid] ++
    (List.finRange 4).map EndpointClip.Port.work ++ (List.finRange 3).map EndpointClip.Port.out).map
      SourceEndpoints.Port.shared ++ (List.finRange 3).map SourceEndpoints.Port.other

def imagePorts : List SourceImages.Port := sourcePorts.map SourceImages.Port.source ++
  (List.finRange 3).map SourceImages.Port.work ++
  (List.finRange 4).flatMap (fun j => [SourceImages.Port.out j false,SourceImages.Port.out j true])
def ports : List Port := imagePorts.map Port.images ++ (List.finRange 4).map Port.threshold ++
  (List.finRange 4).map Port.crossing ++ [.temp]
def heads (p : Port) : Int := 29*(portIndex p : Int)-313

def componentsOracle (u v : Int) (p : Int × Int) : Nat × Nat :=
  (u.natAbs*(if u<0 then (-p.1).toNat else p.1.toNat)+(if v<0 then 0 else v.natAbs*p.2.toNat),
   u.natAbs*(if u<0 then p.1.toNat else (-p.1).toNat)+(if v<0 then v.natAbs*p.2.toNat else 0))

def checkRow (F : RationalMobius) (N : Nat) (i : Fin N) : Bool :=
  let n := PaddedWord.word (PaddedWord.commonConstant F) id (bits N.size N)
  let m := n.length
  let iw := bits m i.val
  let sourcePair (upper : Bool) := if upper then F.rightPair i else F.leftPair i
  let triple (upper : Bool) : Fin 3 → Nat :=
    ![(sourcePair upper).1.toNat,(-(sourcePair upper).1).toNat,(sourcePair upper).2.toNat]
  let imageExpected (j : Fin 4) :=
    let p := sourcePair (decide (2≤j.val))
    if j.val%2=1 then componentsOracle F.integralC F.integralD p
    else componentsOracle F.integralA F.integralB p
  let saved := decide (max F.lo ((i.val : Rat)/N) < min F.hi (((i.val : Rat)+1)/N))
  let A := F.hi.num.natAbs
  let B := F.hi.den
  let sourceWork : Fin 4 → Nat := ![A%2^m,B%2^m,(A*N+(if F.hi.num<0 then 0 else B))%2^m,(B*(i.val+1))%2^m]
  let lastProducts : Fin 3 → Nat := ![F.integralC.natAbs*triple true 0%2^m,
    F.integralC.natAbs*triple true 1%2^m,F.integralD.natAbs*triple true 2%2^m]
  let S := F.lo.num.natAbs+F.lo.den+F.hi.num.natAbs+F.hi.den
  let K := 2*F.integralA.natAbs+F.integralB.natAbs+2*F.integralC.natAbs+F.integralD.natAbs
  let c := NativeZipper.run (program F) (4*N*(18*m+39)+540*m+1349+2*(S+K)*(18*m+52))
    (zipperCfg (start F) (initial n iw) heads)
  let tapes := fun p : SourceImages.Port => c.core.tapes (.images p)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done saved) &&
    decide (tapes (.source (.shared .dimension))=Counter.marked n) &&
    decide (tapes (.source (.shared .index))=Counter.marked iw) &&
    decide (tapes (.source (.shared .unit))=Counter.marked (true::List.replicate (m-1) false)) &&
    decide (tapes (.source (.shared .zero))=Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (tapes (.source (.shared .fuel))=Counter.marked [true]) &&
    decide ((tapes (.source (.shared .scratch))).left=[.start]) &&
    (tapes (.source (.shared .scratch))).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    decide (tapes (.source (.shared .grid))=Counter.marked (bits m (i.val+1))) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j => decide (tapes (.source (.shared (.work j)))=Counter.marked (bits m (sourceWork j)))) &&
    [false,true].all (fun upper => (List.finRange 3).all (fun j =>
      decide (tapes (.source (if upper then .other j else .shared (.out j)))=Counter.marked (bits m (triple upper j))))) &&
    (List.finRange 3).all (fun j => decide (tapes (.work j)=Counter.marked (bits m (lastProducts j)))) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j =>
      decide (tapes (.out j false)=Counter.marked (bits m (imageExpected j).1)) &&
      decide (tapes (.out j true)=Counter.marked (bits m (imageExpected j).2))) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j =>
      let im := imageExpected (if j.val<2 then 0 else 2)
      let value := N*(if j.val%2=0 then im.1 else im.2)
      decide (value<2^m) && decide (c.core.tapes (.threshold j)=Counter.marked (bits m value))) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j =>
      let im := imageExpected 1
      let value := if j.val<2 then (if j.val%2=0 then im.1 else im.2) else 0
      decide (c.core.tapes (.crossing j)=Counter.marked (bits m value))) &&
    decide ((c.core.tapes .temp).left=[.start]) &&
    (c.core.tapes .temp).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    ports.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p=heads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for F in [identityMap,doubleMap,fractionalMap,shiftMap,poleMap,outsideMap,negativeMap,zeroHiMap,negativeCoefficients] do
    count := count+1
    if !checkRow F 1 0 then failures := failures+1
  for F in [fractionalMap,shiftMap] do
    count := count+1
    if !checkRow F 2 1 then failures := failures+1
  count := count+1
  if !checkRow poleMap 4 1 then failures := failures+1
  return (count,failures)
#eval checks
